questions.question: God challenged Job to humble the proud and trample the wicked. If Job could, what would God confess?

answers.text: That Job's own right hand could save him
That Job was right all along
That Job should rule the nations

questions.question: After God spoke to him from the whirlwind, what did Job say he did in dust and ashes?
God told Job that He owes repayment to anyone who has given Him something. True or false?
After God spoke from the whirlwind, how did Job describe the way his knowledge of God had changed?

answers.text: Before he had heard of God but now he had seen Him
Before he had doubted God but now he trusted Him
Before he had feared God but now he loved Him
